resume.summary: I am an example engineer: this profile ships with the repository so the schema is visible, and every sentence in it is invented. Replace this paragraph with your own summary, in the first person - what you build, the languages and systems you build it in, how long you have been doing it, and the one piece of work you would lead with in an interview. Keep it between roughly 450 and 800 characters: the layout reserves about that much space, so a longer summary pushes the rest of the page out and a much shorter one leaves a visible gap. Write it the way you would say it out loud, and do not state anything you could not defend on a whiteboard.
